<p style="font-size: 35px; color: #464340; font-family: penumbrahalfserifstd-reg;">OUR LODGES</p>
<style></style>
	</div>
	<div id="text-2203834886" class="text txt-lodges">
<p style="font-size: 20px; color: #464340; font-family: 'AlegreyaSans-Regular'; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular;"> The 23 spacious lodges built on stilts and widely open to the sea feature wooden lattice panels that allow abundant circulation of fresh breeze, eliminating the need for air conditioning, thus reducing pollutant emissions and providing a new hospitality experience.</span></p>

		<div class="section-content relative">
	<div id="text-3367670057" class="text">
<p style="font-size: 30px; font-family: penumbrahalfserifstd-reg;">SEA VIEW LODGE</p>
<style></style>
	</div>
	<div id="text-1242567261" class="text">
<p style="font-size: 18px; font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; text-align: justify;"> With a partial sea view, this 45 m² <em>ecolodge</em> features a private veranda with a hammock and lounge chairs. It includes a queen-size bed, wardrobe, sofa bed, workspace, and a bathroom area equipped with amenities, as well as a minibar and free Wi-Fi. </p>
<p style="font-size: 18px; font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; text-align: justify;"> Ideal for 2 people, it can accommodate up to 4 guests, with 2 additional persons.</p>

	<section class="section selection-lodge" id="section_639390906">
		<div class="bg section-bg fill bg-fill  bg-loaded" >
		</div>
		<div class="section-content relative">
	<div id="text-75221524" class="text">
<p style="font-size: 30px; font-family: penumbrahalfserifstd-reg;">FAMILY LODGE</p>
<style></style>
	</div>
	<div id="text-4134723061" class="text">
<p style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 18px; text-align: justify;"> With 62 m² and an attached suite, the Family Lodge is ideal for 4 people and can accommodate up to 6 guests, with 2 additional persons.</p>
<p style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 18px; text-align: justify;"> The main lodge features a private veranda with a hammock and lounge chairs. It includes a queen-size bed, wardrobe, sofa bed, workspace, and a bathroom area equipped with amenities, as well as a minibar and free Wi-Fi. </p>
<p style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 18px; text-align: justify;"> The attached suite, connected by a walkway, includes two single beds, a wardrobe, and a full bathroom with amenities.</p>
<p style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 18px; text-align: justify;"> We offer 3 Family Lodge categories: the Ocean Family Lodge, fully facing the sea; the Sea View Family Lodge, with partial sea views; and the River View Family Lodge, overlooking the Jaguaribe River and the dunes located in front of the hotel.</p>
<style></style>
	</div>
		</div>
<style></style>
	</section>

<p style="font-size: 30px; font-family: penumbrahalfserifstd-reg;">GARDEN VIEW LODGE</p>
<style></style>
	</div>
	<div id="text-928735131" class="text">
<p dir="ltr" style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 18px; text-align: justify;"> Overlooking our garden and close to the pool area, this 45 m² ecolodge features a private veranda with a hammock and lounge chairs. It includes a queen-size bed, wardrobe, sofa bed, workspace, and a bathroom area equipped with amenities, as well as a minibar and free Wi-Fi. </p>
<p dir="ltr" style="text-align: justify; font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 18px;"> Ideal para 2 pessoas, podendo acomodar até 4 hóspedes, com 2 pessoas adicionais.</p>

<p style="font-size: 30px; font-family: penumbrahalfserifstd-reg;">RIVER VIEW LODGE</p>
<style></style>
	</div>
	<div id="text-2251010679" class="text">
<p dir="ltr" style="text-align: justify; font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 18px;"> With views of the Jaguaribe River and the dunes located in front of the hotel, this 45 m² <em>ecolodge</em> features a private veranda with a hammock and lounge chairs. It includes a queen-size bed, wardrobe, sofa bed, workspace, and a bathroom area equipped with amenities, as well as a minibar and free Wi-Fi. </p>
<p dir="ltr" style="text-align: justify; font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 18px;"> Ideal for 2 people, it can accommodate up to 4 guests, with 2 additional persons.</p>

<p style="font-size: 28px; color: #464340; font-family: penumbrahalfserifstd-reg;">OUR LODGES</p>

		<div class="section-content relative">
	<div id="text-3808823437" class="text">
<p style="font-size: 23px; font-family: penumbrahalfserifstd-reg;">FAMILY LODGE</p>
<style></style>
	</div>
	<div id="text-1880567622" class="text">
<p style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 16px; text-align: justify;"> With 62 m² and an attached suite, the Family Lodge is ideal for 4 people and can accommodate up to 6 guests, with 2 additional persons.</p>
<p style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 16px; text-align: justify;"> The main lodge features a private veranda with a hammock and lounge chairs. It includes a queen-size bed, wardrobe, sofa bed, workspace, and a bathroom area equipped with amenities, as well as a minibar and free Wi-Fi. </p>
<p style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 16px; text-align: justify;"> The attached suite, connected by a walkway, includes two single beds, a wardrobe, and a full bathroom with amenities.</p>
<p style="font-family: AlegreyaSans-Regular; font-size: 16px; text-align: justify;"> We offer 3 Family Lodge categories: the Ocean Family Lodge, fully facing the sea; the Sea View Family Lodge, with partial sea views; and the River View Family Lodge, overlooking the Jaguaribe River and the dunes located in front of the hotel.</p>
<style></style>

	<div id="text-189720009" class="text">
